notice.title: 安卓版雨甸联机模组正式发布
notice.message:
如你所见，你可以登录你的 Steam 账号进行远程联机。

如果出现报错或者其他意外情况，
那大概是你网有问题。
请检查网络后进行。

来自潮生造物 工作室
notice.message_en:
As you can see, you can now log into your Steam account and play online.

If you run into any errors or unexpected issues,
it is most likely a network problem.
Please check your connection and try again.

From Chaosheng Studio
